formula: Observed prior 512-token HF group wall + future 512-token decode increment. Decode increment point = measured free-run wall_s / 512 generated tokens * 512 additional requested tokens. Sensitivity applies 0.75x–1.50x to only the incremental decode component; observed prefix/teacher-forcing/process component and prior group overhead are held at measured values. This is a cap-length scenario; natural stop before 1024 is unknown. One observed trajectory does not establish a reliable latency distribution.
limitations: No separate prefill or chosen-teacher-forcing wall component exists in the HF result; these remain bundled in the observed prior group wall.
The target requests a second 512-token segment. Exact prefix preservation must be checked against generated_token_ids[:512] from the prior output before attributing any additional generated tokens.
A longer generation cap can change stopping/trajectory; forecast assumes the full 512-token extension is generated.
